title: Hisense HiSmartTV A4 (device xiaoyushan, product xiaoyushan-em, MStar/MediaTek m7322), Android TV 9,
header:
Hisense HiSmartTV A4 (device xiaoyushan, product xiaoyushan-em, MStar/MediaTek m7322), Android TV 9,
firmware PTMR.190127.037 (build 01.00.00.04), security patch 2020-05-05. Sold in India.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/hisense-hismarttv-a4/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/hisense-hismarttv-a4/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

ADB: Developer options has USB debugging only, no Wireless or Network debugging toggle. Turning
USB debugging on opens network ADB on port 5555 directly.
Applied in the four groups below with ~15 s wait and a reboot after each (as the Hisense FFM list
advises): normal boot every time, HDMI 1-3, AV and the tuner still listed by the TV input framework.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (the default in restore.sh). It is not in this list:
launcher/build-and-install.sh disables it after the new launcher is running. The stock home shows a
full-width "Sponsored" banner and a sponsored row, which only goes away with the launcher swap.

Keep: com.mediatek.* (Live TV, HDMI, hotkeys, factory), com.hisense.tv.hitvinput (the HDMI/AV/tuner
inputs), com.hisense.kpad (remote's menu key), com.mstar.netflixobserver (remote's Netflix key),
com.hisense.tv.customerlauncher, com.hisense.uifac, com.hisense.audio_update_service, and
com.hisense.tv.smartsense (left alone because of the Recovery warning in hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm).
Kept by choice: Chromecast (mediashell), Assistant (katniss, pumpkin), Miracast receiver
("Screen Sharing", com.mediatek.androidbox), YouTube.
Already disabled at the factory: com.google.android.backdrop, com.google.android.apps.inputmethod.zhuyin.
